comments.author: Dr Emmanuel Ogungbemi
comments.comment: The gap I see most often is evals at the wrong level. Final-answer grading misses the bad tool call, bad retrieval, or bad handoff that caused the failure, so agent traces need step-level assertions before the judge ever scores the output.

comments.author: Razvan ROMAN
comments.comment: The hard part is not streaming a PTY, it is attribution when humans and agents are both writing into the same process. A useful test: can the audit trail distinguish typed input, pasted multi-line scripts, agent-generated commands, and resumed sessions after reconnect? #AgenticAI

comments.author: Shantanu Ladhwe
comments.comment: The fastest DS to AI engineer shift I’ve seen is when they start owning failure modes after the model call: retries, latency budgets, eval regressions, observability, and bad user inputs. Notebooks teach signal, production teaches surface area.
